company.name: Enstack
company.shortDescription: Enstack is an app-based omnichannel store builder that allows SMEs to build and run their business from their mobile phones.
company.description: Enstack is an app-based omnichannel store builder that empowers SMEs to sell efficiently and effectively. Enstack enables small businesses to establish their online presence through a free web store, as well as expand their reach offline with a mobile POS solution. Enstack also offers multiple payment options, including cash on delivery, wallets, and credit cards, eliminating the hassle of paperwork, while simplifying the process of delivery bookings for both standard and same-day couriers, streamlining operations for businesses.
